problems: Frame 07 (payoff): the picture contradicts the voice. Floey says 'Just not thirty-eight thousand', but the green 'Host: 38,000' pill is still by Maya's head, untouched. It was meant to become a red '38,000' pill with a line through it. The old number still reads as a win at the exact moment the line takes it away.

Frames 08–09 (Maya's 'Wait. Now I have to send them the real number...'): there is no caption in either frame, even though every other spoken line has one. Her line runs about 5 seconds across these two frames, so captions look missing for the turn of the story, and many phone viewers watch with the sound off. In frame 08 her face is also neutral, not the worried slump the script asks for.

Frame 10 (button): the FLOEY speaker tag and caption box sit right on the Flowra spark on the laptop lid and cover half of it. This breaks the rule to keep the logo intact and never hide it. Move the caption or the laptop.

Frame 10: Maya looks down at the laptop. The script has her look straight to camera, deadpan, with one slow blink. That look to camera is the comic button after Floey's line, and it doesn't land here.

Frame 00 (hook): Floey has a happy, eyes-closed smile. The script asks for a deadpan, flat stare as 'the first sign this is about to go wrong'. That tension is missing from the opening frame, so the hook is only Maya cheering.
Frame 01: in this tighter shot, Maya's raised fist is cut off at the right edge of the frame, so the celebratory arm is a stump going off-screen.
